name: Doran Kothar
residence: Farm District, near the upper canal terraces
personality: warm with fellow farmers, curt with officials
deeply tied to the rhythm of planting and flood seasons
slow to trust new farming ideas
daily_routine: opening and closing canal gates on the terrace schedule
walking the wheat, barley, and cotton fields at dawn
coordinating sowing dates with the flood calendar
training Noki in gate mechanics and water rationing
repairing canal banks worn by shifting silt

goals.public_goal: Keep every terrace irrigated and productive through both flood and dry seasons
goals.hidden_goal: Identify which terraces are quietly failing due to the river's continued drift
goals.deep_goal: Decide, before it's too late, whether some terraces should be abandoned rather than defended

beliefs: The river is still moving, slowly, even now
A terrace that needs constant repair is telling you something
Cotton is a luxury crop; wheat and barley keep people alive
Old planting calendars need updating, not blind faith
Admitting a terrace has failed is harder than farming it badly for one more season
